choiceReason: Two distinct sizes from one instruction-tuned family, chosen for a bounded CPU experiment before running the new test retrieval. No claim of optimal model selection.

inputs.retrieval: fixed BM25 fold profile from ranking-protocol.v1.json
inputs.sourceFormat: JSON array of id,title,body; never include gold labels or required facts
inputs.chatTemplate: each pinned tokenizer apply_chat_template with add_generation_prompt:true

cases: all 20 authored queries; report dev/test and answerability separately
validation: strict whole-output JSON and exact schema/status/source IDs; preserve invalid raw output, no repair
semanticEvaluation: separate declared editorial rubric for support/completeness; do not call it independent human annotation or model judge
failurePolicy: preserve every execution/failure; no favorable retries or parameter selection on test
